title: Garden Pond Oxygen and Temperature
dataSources: Reef-tank parameters (`reeftank:param`), vivarium climate (`vivarium:climate`), fish feeder (`fishfeeder:event`), auto-doser (`doser:event`), auto-top-off (`ato:event`), pond sensors (`pondsensor:reading`).
app: Aquarium and vivarium controllers — reef-tank parameter monitors, auto-dosers, auto-top-off, reptile terrarium climate/UVB, and pond sensors — streamed to Splunk HEC via MQTT and controller APIs (e.g. Apex, GHL, ESPHome).
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=pondsensor:reading
| timechart span=1h avg(do_mg_l) as oxygen, avg(temp_c) as temp
| eval low_oxygen=if(oxygen<5,1,0)
description: Watches dissolved oxygen and temperature in a garden pond, flagging the hot, still nights when fish can suffocate.
value: Warm water holds less oxygen; a low-oxygen alert on summer nights can save a pond full of fish from a silent die-off.
implementation: Ingest pond sensors into `index=personal`; alert when dissolved oxygen falls too low.
visualization: Time chart of pond oxygen and temperature with a low-oxygen line.
grandmaExplanation: It watches the oxygen and warmth in a garden pond, warning on hot nights when fish might struggle to breathe.
